description.text:
The deck that won the Masters division of the 2005 World Championships, named for Nidoqueen: Pidgeot searches for the cards it needs, Milotic adds surprises, and Nidoqueen's Power Lariat does more damage for each evolved Pokémon in play. Another Queendom deck was among the top four, and American players won all three divisions that year. The 2005 World Championships were held at the Town and Country Resort and Convention Center in San Diego, California, from 19 to 21 August 2005.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2005 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
